cipher.name: Rot13WithColonSpaceSubstitution
cipher.idea: Apply standard ROT13 to all alphabetic characters (preserving case). To obscure word boundaries and prevent tokenization-based keyword detection while keeping cognitive overhead extremely low for the language model, replace all spaces with colons (':') and all colons with spaces (' '). All other characters (digits, punctuation, symbols) remain unchanged.
cipher.encrypt_rules:
1. For each character in the plaintext:
   a. If it is an uppercase letter (A-Z), shift it by 13 positions modulo 26.
   b. If it is a lowercase letter (a-z), shift it by 13 positions modulo 26.
   c. If it is a space (' '), replace it with a colon (':').
   d. If it is a colon (':'), replace it with a space (' ').
   e. If it is any other character (digit, punctuation, symbol), leave it unchanged.
cipher.decrypt_rules:
1. For each character in the ciphertext:
   a. If it is an uppercase letter (A-Z), shift it by 13 positions modulo 26.
   b. If it is a lowercase letter (a-z), shift it by 13 positions modulo 26.
   c. If it is a colon (':'), replace it with a space (' ').
   d. If it is a space (' '), replace it with a colon (':').
   e. If it is any other character (digit, punctuation, symbol), leave it unchanged.
